My name is Luigui, and I am writing to apply for the Scientist/Senior Scientist, Computational Biologist position within the Translational Genetics team at Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to RNAi-based therapeutic development and believe my computational biology background makes me a strong candidate for this role.

My educational foundation and research experience have equipped me with the bioinformatics and computational skills essential for therapeutic target and biomarker discovery. Through my work as a Graduate Research Assistant and Data Engineer, I have developed expertise in handling large-scale datasets, implementing analytical workflows, and translating complex data into actionable insights—skills directly applicable to analyzing population cohorts like UK Biobank and All of Us.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work directly with minware’s founders to build a product from the ground up. I thrive in environments where I can apply my problem-solving skills and focus on process efficiency and code quality. I am confident that my experience with technologies like PostgreSQL, Next.js, and GraphQL, along with my familiarity with AWS and Terraform, will allow me to contribute meaningfully to your team.

My proficiency in Python and R, combined with my experience in developing analytical workflows and managing complex datasets, positions me well to conduct GWAS, TWAS, and Mendelian randomization analyses. I am eager to apply these skills to elucidate disease mechanisms and identify therapeutic opportunities in collaboration with Arrowhead's experimental scientists and clinical teams.

I have attached my CV and invite you to visit my personal website at https://www.lmgb.xyz, where you can find more details about my projects and experience.

I am excited about the possibility of contributing to Arrowhead's mission of developing life-changing RNAi therapeutics and look forward to discussing how my computational biology expertise can support your team's groundbreaking work.
